steps.cadences: A cadence is the way a phrase ends: the punctuation of music. An authentic cadence goes from V to I and sounds finished, like a period. A half cadence stops on V and sounds unfinished, like a comma.
steps.twoEndings: Every phrase starts the same way. Listen to how it ends.
steps.plagal: A plagal cadence goes from IV to I. It’s gentler than V to I: it’s the “Amen” at the end of many hymns.
steps.threeEndings: All three now. Listen to the last two chords.
steps.build: Now play the chords behind those endings, in different keys.
